Mali.title: Ségou: Three suspects arrested in connection with the murder of a young man in Markala
Mali.summary: Three suspects were arrested on Thursday 19 November 2026 as part of the investigation into the murder of a young man, which took place on 12 November in Markala, 35 km from Ségou. The victim had been killed on a construction site belonging to his brother. According to local sources, the suspects are being held at the gendarmerie.

Mali.title: Mali: Algerian secret services reportedly seeking to resume mediation with the FLA, according to Africa Intelligence
Mali.summary: The Algerian secret services are reportedly seeking to re-establish a channel of dialogue between the Malian authorities and the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA), according to Africa Intelligence. "As a new offensive by armed groups looms, the Algerian secret services are struggling to reactivate channels of mediation between the Malian state and the Tuareg rebels allied with the jihadists of GSIM," wrote the specialised media outlet on X, on 24 November 2026.

Mali.title: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara becomes a victim of cyberbullying after her advice
Mali.summary: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara victim of cyberharassment after her advice Given the deaths in clandestine emigration in recent weeks, all Senegalese opinion leaders are talking about it and advising young people who are thinking of doing so. As the tragedies of clandestine emigration have multiplied in recent weeks, there are an increasing number of Senegalese voices calling on young people to give up on leaving.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: China-Solomon Islands: Beijing defends its cooperation in the Pacific
Mali.summary: Bamako, 24 November (AMAP) China stated on Tuesday that its cooperation with Pacific island countries is not aimed at geopolitical competition or confrontation between blocs, amid reports of a possible non-renewal of its security agreement with the Solomon Islands. "China is developing its relations with the Solomon Islands on the basis of mutual respect and equality," said Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun at a press briefing in Beijing.

Mali.title: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes servicemen released from captivity
Mali.summary: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes soldiers released from captivity General Oumar Diarra, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, welcomed Malian soldiers recently released from captivity on 23 November 2026. These soldiers had been captured during the coordinated attacks of 25 April 2026, particularly in the Kidal region. According to Major General Elizée Jean Dao, Chief of Staff of the Army, their release is the result of a major operation carried out by the command.

Mali.title: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMA and Africa Corps, or an operation carried out without fighting?
Mali.summary: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMa and Africa Corps, or operation carried out without a fight? On 18 November, the Malian army and its Russian partners announced that they had freed 24 soldiers being held near Kidal. But behind the spectacular images released by Africa Corps, the reality of the operation is said to be less heroic.

Niger.title: Urban security: around thirty unlicensed taxis seized during an inspection operation in Niamey
Niger.summary: As part of its efforts to regulate and make urban transport safer, the Urban Transport Department of the City of Niamey (DTU) carried out an operation this weekend to check and sweep for vehicles operating without regulatory authorisation, particularly in markets and busy areas of the capital. The operation, which covered several neighbourhoods and junctions in the capital, resulted in the seizure of vehicles used for the illegal transport of people, including around thirty unlicensed taxis.
